question: What fun toy can you create just by folding a square piece of paper? 📄
explanation: Great job! By folding paper carefully, you can create a cute paper boat that actually floats! ⛵
hint: It can float on water during the rain.

question: What toy can you fold from paper that flies in the air? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! A paper airplane glides beautifully through the air when you throw it! ✈️
hint: It has wings like a real plane.

question: What soft material do we use to make small pots and toys? 🏺
explanation: Super! Soft clay can be pressed and rolled to make lovely pots and shapes! 🏺
hint: It feels like soft, wet mud.

question: If you roll a piece of clay back and forth, what shape will it become? 🐍
explanation: Great job! Rolling clay makes it long and thin, just like a little snake! 🐍
hint: It becomes long and wiggly.

question: What can you make using an old, empty shoe box? 📦
explanation: Awesome! An empty shoe box is perfect for building a cute little toy house! 🏠
hint: You can cut doors and windows into it.

question: What sticky thing helps us join two pieces of paper together? 🧴
explanation: Super! Glue is very sticky and holds our paper crafts together perfectly! 🧴
hint: It comes in a small bottle or stick.

question: What is the safest tool for kids to cut paper? ✂️
explanation: Great job! Kid scissors have round edges and are safe to use for cutting! ✂️
hint: You use two fingers to open and close them.

question: What can you make out of an old, colorful sock? 🧦
explanation: Awesome! You can put your hand inside a sock and stick on eyes to make a fun puppet! 🧸
hint: It can talk when you move your hand!

question: What can you build by joining empty matchboxes together? 🚂
explanation: Super! Matchboxes look like train coaches when you stick them in a line! 🚂
hint: It goes Chug-Chug-Chug!

question: What can you use as wheels for your toy cardboard car? 🛞
explanation: Great job! Round plastic bottle caps make the perfect spinning wheels! 🛞
hint: They are round and cover bottles.

question: What can you create to cool yourself down using folded paper? 🪭
explanation: Awesome! A folded paper fan gives wonderful cool air when you wave it! 🪭
hint: You move it back and forth to get air.

question: What is the Japanese art of folding paper called? 🦢
explanation: Super! Origami is the magic of folding one paper into beautiful birds and animals! 🦢
hint: It starts with the letter 'O'.

question: What shape do we usually start with to fold a paper boat? 🟦
explanation: Great job! A square piece of paper is best for folding most origami toys! 🟦
hint: It has four equal sides.

question: What body parts do we mostly use to shape and model clay? 🖐️
explanation: Awesome! Our fingers press, pinch, and roll the soft clay to make shapes! 🖐️
hint: We have ten of them on our hands.

question: Where should we keep our wet clay pots so they become hard? ☀️
explanation: Super! The warm sun dries the wet clay and makes the pots strong and hard! ☀️
hint: It gives us heat and light outside.

question: What fun toy can you make using two paper cups and a long string? ☎️
explanation: Great job! You can talk to your friend through a fun string and cup phone! ☎️
hint: You use it to say 'Hello' from far away.

question: What can you make out of clean ice cream sticks? 🖼️
explanation: Awesome! Sticking ice cream sticks together makes a lovely frame for your pictures! 🖼️
hint: You put your favorite photograph in it.

question: What beautiful thing can we make by pasting dried leaves on paper? 🍂
explanation: Super! Different shapes of dry leaves can be pasted to look like elephants or birds! 🍂
hint: You use brown or yellow fallen leaves.

question: What do we use to add beautiful colors to our dried clay pots? 🎨
explanation: Great job! We use a brush and colorful paint to make our clay pots look amazing! 🎨
hint: It comes in red, blue, green, and yellow.

question: What can you make from a paper plate to wear on your face? 🎭
explanation: Awesome! By cutting eye holes and drawing, a paper plate becomes a fun mask! 🎭
hint: You wear it to look like a lion or a tiger.

question: What can you use to hold your pens that is made from an old plastic bottle? 🖍️
explanation: Super! Cutting the top off a bottle turns it into a handy pen and pencil stand! 🖍️
hint: It sits on your study table.

question: What shiny dust do we sprinkle to make our crafts sparkle? ✨
explanation: Great job! Glitter shines brightly and makes all our paper crafts look magical! ✨
hint: It sparkles in the light.

question: What do you build when you stack many blocks one on top of the other? 🧱
explanation: Awesome! Stacking blocks upwards creates a really tall and fun tower! 🗼
hint: It reaches high up into the air.

question: What can you join together to make a paper chain? ⛓️
explanation: Super! Looping colorful paper strips together makes a beautiful, long chain! ⛓️
hint: Long, thin pieces of colored paper.

question: What toy spins round and round when the wind blows? 🎡
explanation: Great job! A paper pinwheel catches the wind and spins beautifully! 🎡
hint: It looks like a little fan on a stick.

question: What is the most important rule after we finish our fun craft work? 🧹
explanation: Awesome! Cleaning our space makes sure the room is tidy and ready for next time! 🧹
hint: Putting things back in their place.

question: What tool helps us draw perfectly straight lines on paper? 📏
explanation: Super! A ruler has a straight edge that helps us draw very neat lines! 📏
hint: It is also called a scale.

question: What do we call the thick, strong paper used for making boxes? 📦
explanation: Great job! Cardboard is thick and strong, making it perfect for building structures! 📦
hint: Your toys usually come packed inside this.

question: What can we make by folding an old newspaper to carry things? 🛍️
explanation: Awesome! We can fold and glue newspapers to make strong bags for shopping! 🛍️
hint: You use it instead of a plastic bag.

question: What kind of line do we cut along to make a zig-zag shape? 📈
explanation: Super! Cutting along a zig-zag line gives the paper a cool, pointy edge! 📈
hint: It goes up and down like a mountain.

question: What can you make for your head out of a long strip of gold paper? 👑
explanation: Great job! A gold paper strip can be wrapped around your head to make a king's crown! 👑
hint: Royalty wears this on their heads.

question: What natural object from a tree branch is fun to paint on? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! You can paint dots and stripes on a stick to make a magic wand! 🪵
hint: It falls from trees.

question: What sticky strip do we use to quickly join two boxes without glue? 🩹
explanation: Super! Clear tape is strong and very fast to use when building with boxes! 🩹
hint: It comes on a roll and is clear.

question: What shape do you make when you roll clay into a perfect little sphere? ⚽
explanation: Great job! Rolling clay between your hands makes a perfect, round ball! ⚽
hint: It looks like a marble.

question: What can you tie around an empty tin can to make a drum? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! Stretching a balloon over a tin can makes a fun toy drum! 🥁
hint: It is rubbery and stretches tight.

question: What should the base of a tall tower block be to stop it from falling? 💪
explanation: Super! A wide and strong base keeps your lovely tower from tumbling down! 💪
hint: It needs to hold all the weight.

question: What do we use to color our beautiful drawings and crafts? 🖍️
explanation: Great job! Crayons bring all the bright, happy colors to our artwork! 🖍️
hint: They are made of wax and have many colors.

question: What useful thing can you make from a big empty cardboard box? 🧸
explanation: Awesome! Decorating a big box makes a perfect chest to keep all your toys safe! 🧸
hint: A place to store things in your room.

question: What string-like material is best for tying a mask to your face? 🧵
explanation: Super! Soft thread or elastic holds the mask gently without hurting you! 🧵
hint: You use it for sewing clothes.

question: What beautiful flower can you fold out of red paper? 🌹
explanation: Great job! You can twist and fold red paper to look exactly like a blooming rose! 🌹
hint: It has beautiful red petals.

question: What fun items from an old shirt can be pasted for decoration? 🔘
explanation: Awesome! Buttons have lovely colors and holes, making them perfect for crafts! 🔘
hint: They close up shirts and coats.

question: What do we make when we paste many pictures on a large chart paper? 🖼️
explanation: Super! A collage is a wonderful artwork made by pasting lots of pictures together! 🖼️
hint: It starts with the letter 'C'.

question: What can you make out of two sticks and a piece of cloth? ⛺
explanation: Great job! Draping a cloth over joined sticks makes a cute toy tent! ⛺
hint: You sleep inside it when camping.

question: What fun sound object can you make by filling a small bottle with seeds? 🪇
explanation: Awesome! Seeds inside a bottle make a fun shaking sound like a musical instrument! 🪇
hint: You shake it to the beat of music.

question: What soft, fluffy thing can you glue on paper to look like white clouds? ☁️
explanation: Super! Cotton is soft, white, and fluffy, just like real clouds in the sky! ☁️
hint: It is white and used in pillows.

question: What is the best way to fold paper to make a fan? 📉
explanation: Great job! Folding paper back and forth in zig-zags creates a perfect cooling fan! 📉
hint: Like walking left, then right, then left.

question: What can you use to decorate the roof of your cardboard toy house? 🖌️
explanation: Awesome! Brightly colored paint makes the roof of your toy house look beautiful! 🖌️
hint: You apply it with a brush.

question: What is crafting and creating new things all about? 🎉
explanation: Super! Creating things with our own hands is the most fun and happy activity! 🎉
hint: It makes you smile and laugh.

question: What small things can you string together to make a beautiful necklace? 📿
explanation: Great job! Threading little beads together makes a lovely necklace to wear! 📿
hint: They have tiny holes in the middle.

question: What do we call thick paper folded in half with a beautiful message inside? 💌
explanation: Awesome! We make greeting cards to show love to our family and friends! 💌
hint: You give it on birthdays.
